title: Learn New Skills with Microcredentials

source.name: VOA Learning English — Learn New Skills with Microcredentials
source.license: Nội dung của VOA (Voice of America), phạm vi công cộng
source.note: Đã rút gọn: chỉ giữ một số đoạn.

paras: In today’s workplace, what you learned in the usual college courses may not be very useful later in life.
For example, in the field of information technology, workers might never use BASIC, the computer language that was taught in the 1990s. But they might need to know Python or SQL.
The answer for students or workers is a professional certificate program, or what is called microcredential.

UNESCO, the world’s education agency, defines microcredential as professional certification that centers on a set of learning outcomes in a narrow field. It is completed over a shorter time than a traditional university program, from a week to a month.

The most popular fields in which microcredentials appear are data analytics , information technology support and cybersecurity . The courses are often developed by technology businesses like Google, Salesforce, Meta, Intuit and IBM. The businesses provide a certificate when a student finishes the course.

Coursera, an online educational service, recently released a report on how microcredentials are preparing students for jobs and affecting higher education schools. It says that 51 percent of colleges in the United States that offer microcredentials also provide school credit and more plan to do so in the next few years.

Some colleges include one or more courses leading to microcredentials as part of their usual programs. At Hawaii Pacific University, school leaders say including professional certifications in its business program has sharply increased the number of interested students.
For students, Credential Finder offers a way to search for the right microcredential offerings by field of study or industry.

For example, if you are studying information science, you may take Google Data Analytics or an IBM Data Analyst course. If you are working toward a degree in business administration, you may take a Google Project Management course. Your university program’s advisors should be helpful in identifying the best certificate programs for your area of study.
Many of the course providers permit learners to use the materials for free, but to earn a certification, payment is required.
Coursera has a monthly fee of $59 or a yearly fee of $399 for its Coursera Plus membership. For courses that universities offer for credit, the payment will depend on the price set by the school.

questions.q: Why does the writer mention BASIC, Python and SQL?
options: To explain which company first invented the idea of microcredentials
To show that skills in demand change, so old course content can go out of date
To prove that any computer language can be learned within one week
To compare the prices of several different coding courses online
questions.explain: Đoạn 1–2: nội dung học ở đại học có thể không còn hữu ích; BASIC (1990s) không còn dùng, thay vào đó là Python/SQL → kiến thức nhanh lỗi thời.

questions.q: How is a microcredential different from a traditional university programme?
options: It is only open to people who already have a job in the same field
It covers a wide range of different subjects over a period of several years
It focuses on one narrow subject and takes far less time to finish
It is always taught by professors who work at a university
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: UNESCO định nghĩa là chứng nhận trong “a narrow field”, hoàn thành “over a shorter time … from a week to a month”.

questions.q: Who often designs the courses and awards the certificates?
options: The education agency of the United Nations itself
Large firms from the technology industry
Government offices that deal with employment and training
Universities that work together without any help from companies
questions.explain: Đoạn 5: các khóa “are often developed by technology businesses like Google, Salesforce, Meta, Intuit and IBM” và các công ty này cấp chứng chỉ.

questions.q: What does the Coursera report suggest about colleges and microcredentials?
options: About half of the colleges that offer them also give credit, and more may follow
Every college that offers them gives students academic credit for them
Colleges are closing their regular courses because of the new programmes
Very few colleges are interested in offering any microcredentials at all
questions.explain: Đoạn 6: 51% trường “also provide school credit and more plan to do so” → khoảng một nửa đã tính tín chỉ và nhiều trường dự định làm vậy.

questions.q: What happened when Hawaii Pacific University added professional certifications to its business programme?
options: Tuition fees for business students were lowered the next year
Fewer students chose to study business at the university
The university stopped offering all of its traditional courses
Many more students became interested in joining the programme
questions.explain: Đoạn 7: số sinh viên quan tâm “sharply increased”.

questions.q: What does the writer advise a student who is unsure which certificate to choose?
options: Take every course that one big company has on offer
Wait until after graduation before making any decision
Choose whichever course happens to be the cheapest one
Ask for help from the advisers in their own university programme
questions.explain: Đoạn 9: “Your university program’s advisors should be helpful in identifying the best certificate programs for your area of study.”

questions.q: Learners can often study the materials without paying, but they have to pay to receive a certificate.
questions.explain: Đoạn 10: nhiều nơi cho dùng tài liệu miễn phí nhưng “to earn a certification, payment is required”.

questions.q: Most employers prefer job applicants with microcredentials to those with university degrees.
questions.explain: Bài không nói gì về sự ưa chuộng của nhà tuyển dụng.

str.explain: may (not) + be + tính từ: nói về khả năng, không chắc chắn.

str.ex: workers might never use BASIC, the computer language that was taught in the 1990s
str.explain: might + never + động từ: nói về khả năng không xảy ra.

str.s: It is completed over a shorter time than …
str.vi: Được hoàn thành trong thời gian ngắn hơn …
str.ex: It is completed over a shorter time than a traditional university program, from a week to a month.
str.explain: Bị động + so sánh hơn với than.

str.vi: nếu bạn đang …, bạn có thể …
